biggest_catch: This is a BUSINESS checking offer — you need a business to qualify — and the bonus only pays in the sixth month after opening, plus the account must keep a $5,000 monthly average balance or it charges $20/month.
catches: Business customers only: you must be a new First Merchants Bank business checking client; existing business checking customers and anyone who closed one on or after 3/1/2026 are not eligible.
Ask an FMB banker to enroll you in the 'BUS-2026 Checking Offer' when opening — the bonus is not automatic.
You must deposit at least $5,000 within the first 7 calendar days of opening to earn the $300 tier ($15,000 for the $750 tier).
The account must maintain a $5,000 monthly average collected balance or a $20 monthly service fee applies — fees can eat the bonus if you open late and close late.
The bonus is credited in the sixth month following account opening (not immediately) and appears on the statement as 'New Checking Offer Reward.'
If the account is closed within 6 months of opening, you may be charged back the full bonus amount plus a $50 early-closing fee.
Bonus is taxable and reported to the IRS; one offer per client.
Offer period March 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026; the bank may change or discontinue it at any time.

steps: Confirm on https://www.firstmerchants.com/bus2026 that the BUS-2026 offer is still active (it ends September 30, 2026).
Open a new Basic Business Checking account with an FMB banker between March 1, 2026 and September 30, 2026, and explicitly ask to be enrolled in the 'BUS-2026 Checking Offer'.
Deposit at least $5,000 into the new account within the first 7 calendar days of opening (this earns the $300 tier; $15,000 earns the $750 tier).
Maintain a $5,000 monthly average collected balance to avoid the $20 monthly service fee.
Keep the account open for at least 6 months — closing earlier can trigger a clawback of the full bonus plus a $50 early-closing fee.
In the sixth month after account opening, look for the 'New Checking Offer Reward' credit on your statement; report it as income for tax purposes.
timing: Bonus credited to the account in the sixth month following account opening.
